description: List the job applications in the user's TakeMeUp job tracker: company, role, status (saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected), the CV used and follow-up dates. Free. Use when the user asks about their applications, follow-ups or job-search progress.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: list_my_takemeup_applications
title: List my job applications
